title: Defang security incident, Nov 2026

subject.name: Defang
subject.about: Defang makes tools for developers. Defang Deploy takes an application described in a Compose file and deploys it into the customer's own AWS, Google Cloud or Azure account. Defang Station runs AI coding agents on a hosted machine.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Defang, GitHub, Stripe, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: One company and the developers who use it. Every Defang Portal account is in the copied database; Defang has not said how many. Which organisations' repositories and cloud accounts the stolen app key could reach is not known.
who_is_affected: Everyone with a Defang Portal account. Users of the Defang GitHub App should check their repositories and cloud deploy role for activity since Nov 11. Anyone who deployed with Defang between Oct 12 and Nov 19 should change database passwords and secrets.

known.text: Defang says an attacker got into its build system on Nov 12 and copied the credentials it runs on.
Defang's main database was copied, with every Defang Portal account in it.
The key to the Defang GitHub App and customers' stored GitHub tokens were taken, and worked until Nov 23.
Saved copies of deployments from Oct 12 to Nov 19, which can include database passwords, were taken.

not_known.text: Which organisations use Defang, and whether any were affected.
Whether the stolen credentials were used after Nov 12.
